attributes.name: Cryptic Runes
attributes.powers:
If undefeated, discard the top card of your deck; each character at this location is dealt 2d4 Fire damage.

If defeated, examine the top two cards of this location deck and return them in any order. You may then immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from.
